title: t3rag v1: Rust-native RAG over thinking traces
description:
Single Rust binary `t3rag` (clap subcommands: index / search / serve / mcp / skill) implementing RAG over thinking traces per DESIGN.md.

Locked decisions (DESIGN.md §8): Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B via ort+ONNX (not candle/fastembed primary); usearch dense index; tantivy BM25 + RRF hybrid; BGE cross-encoder reranker in v1; daemon keeps model+indexes resident (HTTP + streamable-HTTP MCP); stdio `t3rag mcp` proxies to daemon; corpus is user-provided (JSONL / parquet / dir of md|txt); pure Rust, no Python, no API keys.

Latency budget (warm daemon): ~200-700ms CPU / ~50-150ms GPU. Quality presets --fast/--balanced/--max.

title: Scaffold t3rag crate: clap subcommands, modules, build profiles
description:
`cargo` binary `t3rag` with clap subcommand skeleton: index, search, serve, mcp, skill. Module layout: embed, store, index (usearch+tantivy), search, serve, mcp, cli.

Build config per DESIGN.md §6: `[profile.release] lto="thin", codegen-units=1, strip=true`; dev `debug="line-tables-only"`; `.cargo/config.toml` rust-lld; minimal tokio/rmcp feature sets; GPU backends feature-gated off by default.

Acceptance: `cargo build` produces `t3rag`; every subcommand `--help` works; `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check` clean.

title: Reranker: BGE cross-encoder via ort, truncated parallel scoring
description: Two-stage retrieval stage 2 per DESIGN.md §5: BGE cross-encoder (bge-reranker family) via `ort`/ONNX scores each (query, passage) pair for top ~50 candidates. Truncate passages to ~1024 tokens before scoring; rayon-parallel pair scoring; `--rerank`/`--no-rerank` flag (default on). Smaller cross-encoder option (MiniLM ~33M) for `--fast`.

title: Chunking: structural split over 8K tokens + parent hydration
description: Chunking policy per DESIGN.md §7/§9 (open question): default whole-passage embedding; only chunk when a passage exceeds ~8K tokens; split on structural boundaries (step markers, headers, paragraph breaks), light/no overlap; store `parent_id` + `chunk_idx`, match chunks but return full parent (parent hydration). Verify empirically — A/B whole vs chunked on the fixture + sample queries.

title: t3rag serve: daemon, tokio HTTP, ORT session pool, warmup
description: `t3rag serve` daemon per DESIGN.md §6: tokio HTTP on 127.0.0.1:PORT with model + indexes resident (usearch mmap, pooled tantivy readers). ORT sessions aren't safely concurrent → semaphore-pool 2-4 sessions on dedicated inference threads (not tokio tasks). Startup warmup (dummy embed+search). `--idle-timeout` to unload; ~1-3GB RAM resident.

title: Search thin-client: auto-detect/spawn daemon, --no-daemon
description: Per DESIGN.md §6 "one daemon, three thin front-ends": `t3rag search` becomes a thin HTTP client — auto-detects running daemon, auto-spawns one if absent, `--no-daemon` forces the cold in-process path for minimal footprint.

title: MCP: rmcp streamable-HTTP + t3rag mcp stdio proxy
description: MCP interface per DESIGN.md §6: `rmcp` SDK, tool `search_traces(query, corpus?, top_k?) -> passages`. Streamable-HTTP transport served by the daemon; `t3rag mcp` is a stdio MCP that PROXIES to the daemon (never loads the model itself). Fallback: hand-rolled JSON-RPC (~200 lines) if rmcp's dep tree hurts compile times.

title: t3rag skill: emit/install SKILL.md wrapper
description: `t3rag skill` emits/installs a SKILL.md wrapper so agents discover the retrieval tool (DESIGN.md §6). Optional/thin — the MCP endpoint is the primary agent interface.

title: Quality presets --fast/--balanced/--max + query LRU
description: Quality presets + perf knobs per DESIGN.md §6: `--fast` (tiny/no reranker + smallest embedder, ~50-150ms), `--balanced` (default, Qwen3-0.6B + truncated parallel rerank, ~200-500ms), `--max` (4B/8B + full rerank). Query LRU cache; surface i8 vector quantization option; GPU/Metal auto-detect.

title: Eval + bench: latency budget, A/B whole vs chunked
description: Eval + benchmark harness: measure the §6 latency budget stage-by-stage on CPU (embed / ANN+BM25+RRF / rerank); A/B retrieval quality whole-passage vs chunked on the fixture corpus + sample queries; record results and close the DESIGN.md §9 chunking open question.

title: CI: GitHub Actions fmt + clippy -D warnings + test
description: GitHub Actions workflow: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test` on push/PR to main. Cache cargo; consider rch offload later if runner time hurts.

title: Passage store: packed passages.bin + .idx with mmap reader
description: Packed binary passage store per DESIGN.md §7: `passages.bin` (length-prefixed blobs) + `passages.idx` (offset table) with `memmap2` random-access reader (~0 RAM). `meta.json` per corpus: model, dims, quantization, doc_count, format_version. Corpus root: `~/.cache/t3rag/corpora/<name>/`.

title: Corpus ingest: JSONL, .md/.txt dir, parquet
description: Corpus ingest per DESIGN.md §7: JSONL (one passage/line; `text` required, `question`/`title`/`source` optional), directory of `.md`/`.txt` (filename → title), parquet via `parquet`+`arrow` streaming row groups with `--text-col` auto-detect (text/content/passage). User-provided corpus only — no HF dependency.

title: Test fixture: small T3-style sample corpus
description: Small sample corpus for tests/eval (~50-100 passages) mimicking t3_struct / t3_reflect / t3_semantic passage shapes (multi-step reasoning scaffolds, contrastive mistake notes, compressed reasoning cores). JSONL + a small .md dir. Lets tests and the chunking A/B run without downloading HF `narabzad/t3-*` datasets.

title: Embedder: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B via ort + ONNX
description: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B via `ort` + ONNX per DESIGN.md §3/§8: `hf-hub` download of `onnx-community/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-ONNX` (prefer uint8/fp16), `tokenizers` encode, instruction prefix for queries, forward, last-token pooling, L2 normalize — the standard recipe (~200 lines, hand-rolled). Batch embedding API for index path. `--model` flag leaves room for 4B/8B/BGE-M3/e5-large/jina-v2-code. Fallback: fastembed only if the ONNX export misbehaves.

title: Dense index: usearch HNSW build/save/load, i8, mmap
description: Dense ANN via `usearch` per DESIGN.md §4/§7: single-file `vectors.usearch` HNSW index, i8/bf16/fp32 quantization (i8 default — ~4x smaller, better cache locality), mmap load for daemon. Sanity-check recall vs brute-force scan on the fixture corpus.

title: Lexical index: tantivy BM25 over passages
description: `tantivy` BM25 index per corpus under `bm25/` (DESIGN.md §4): fields text (+title/question when present). Traces carry exact-match signals (identifiers, theorem names, variable names) dense vectors underweight. Target ~1ms query.

title: t3rag index: end-to-end pipeline ingest to usearch+tantivy
description: `t3rag index --input <jsonl|dir|parquet> --name <corpus>` end-to-end per DESIGN.md §6: read passages → pack into passage store → rayon-parallel embed batches → build usearch + tantivy → write meta.json. Idempotent re-index; reports doc count/dims.

title: t3rag search: query embed, ANN+BM25, RRF, top-k
description: `t3rag search "<query>" [--corpus X] [--top-k 3] [--json]` per DESIGN.md §4/§6: embed query → usearch ANN + tantivy BM25 → RRF fusion → top-k passages printed. Auto-build corpus if missing. Cold/in-process path (no daemon) in this bead; thin-client daemon mode is a separate bead.
